payload.entry: Tale finish_merge_copy_landing closes epic: fixed merge-copy sanitization to strip only live identity outside inline/fenced code with real task-row recognition (plain #task prose untouched); made copied/fragment fence scanners length-aware so triple backtick no longer closes quadruple fence and tilde fences survive; applied same protection to shared transplant link repair without changing move/split relocation. Corrected docs/task-merge.md copy rule to explicitly protect code and fixed bare-note vocabulary; corrected bob-mac-capture docs/capture-transfers.md landing cards to show cancelled headline + LINKS and copied-note count, keeping removed-run fold for moves/older responses, regenerated mounts via docs tooling. Tests: new merge_copy_preserves_inline_code, merge_copy_fence_length (cross-note + same-note target-above-source, origin tracking, reconcile no-op, repeatability), and MG18 bound-archive regression using production pairing resolver (metadata-bound noncanonical archive, external + copied links follow bound archive, no duplicate identities); move/split regressions pass. Verification: just check passed, just docs-check passed in bob-cli and bob-mac-capture, scratch-vault binary shows '2 notes copied', literal [id::] preserved, live [id::]/^id stripped in copy only, source byte-identical apart from retirement, LINKED FROM/LINKS intact. Decisions: no memory changes in tale (glossary already done, no decision record). Follow-ups: je.2 index budgets corroborate bob-cli-f8 with fresh isolated evidence; viewport/Live Preview corroborates bob-cli-ej; stylesheet contracts owned by bob-cli-j8.6.1 phase .2; macOS watchdog corroborates bob-cli-h7 (clean 5a28892/run 42725824824 vs a5a0ffb runs); no duplicate tasks filed. epic-symbols none; just symvision absent.
